page_title: ATA 2-0 FIO | Atalanta v Fiorentina 30/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.

90+4' Marco Carnesecchi doesn't have to worry about that one. Niccolo Fortini puts a cross in towards Amir Richardson (Fiorentina), who is unable to keep his header on target from the centre of the box. He sends the ball well wide of the right post.
90+3' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
90+2' Amir Richardson (Fiorentina) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Albert Gudmundsson, but Marco Carnesecchi displays great awareness to stop him.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' It’s the correct decision – NO PENALTY for Atalanta! VAR comes to the rescue of referee Matteo Marcenaro and both teams have no complaints.
90' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Atalanta! Let's see what he decides.
90' CHANCE! Charles De Ketelaere finds Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) with a sweet pass, but he can't find the target as his effort from inside the box goes just wide of the right post!
90' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
89' Amir Richardson (Fiorentina) commits a rough challenge and Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle for a foul.
89' The current number of corner kicks is 4:5.
88' Nikola Krstovic loses the ball after receiving a sweet pass from Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta).
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) comes onto the pitch for Isak Hien.
86' Nicola Zalewski floats over the corner and Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) gets on the end of it, but his header from around the penalty spot sails well wide of the right post.
86' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) will take the corner.

86' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) connects with a precise cross inside the goalmouth and shoots. One of the defending players reacts in time and clears the ball to safety. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Atalanta.
84' Poorly taken free kick by Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) from mid-range. He unleashes a strong shot, but it goes well wide of the right post. What a miskick!
84' Isak Hien (Atalanta) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
83' Fiorentina players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
82' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) is penalised for a foul. Matteo Marcenaro had a clear view and blows his whistle.
80' Substitution. Roberto Piccoli will be replaced by Amir Richardson (Fiorentina).
79' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Cher Ndour (Fiorentina) will replace Simon Sohm.
79' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina) offside.
77' Raffaele Palladino prepares a substitution. Ademola Lookman is replaced by Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta).
77' The referee allows time for a substitution. Gianluca Scamacca will be replaced by Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta).

76' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) shows good awareness inside the box as he latches on to a cross from the set piece. He jumps high but his towering header lacks a little bit of accuracy and glances off the left-hand post.
76' Referee Matteo Marcenaro sees the trip by Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Fiorentina.
75' Pablo Mari goes off the pitch and Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina) comes on.
74' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
71' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
71' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) receives a yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee.
69' Pablo Mari (Fiorentina) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
69' The total number of attempts is 18:12. The shots on goal statistics – 9:4.
67' Here is a change. Ederson is going off and Raffaele Palladino gives the last tactical orders to Mario Pasalic (Atalanta).
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) replaces Davide Zappacosta.
66' The ball is cleared after Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
64' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) meets a cross on the edge of the box and produces a header towards the bottom left corner, but one of the defending players blocks the effort.
64' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) is about to take a corner kick.
64' Paolo Vanoli decides to make a substitution. Dodo will be replaced by Niccolo Fortini (Fiorentina).
64' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Nicolo Fagioli.

63' Dodo (Fiorentina) evades several challenges inside the box and fires a shot in on goal, but that's a great block by the defender to stop an almost certain goal. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina have been awarded a corner kick.
62' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
62' A dangerous looking corner kick from Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) is cleared to safety by the defence. The referee blows his whistle, Fiorentina are awarded a corner kick.
62' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
61' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
60' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.

59' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Marin Pongracic (Fiorentina) was quite harsh and Matteo Marcenaro didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card. Marin Pongracic (Fiorentina) will miss the next game.
58' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
57' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) moves forward and unleashes a thunderous shot from distance that flies well over the bar.

54' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the bottom right corner. David de Gea shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
53' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) receives the ball inside the penalty box and immediately fires a first-time effort, but it goes well over the top.

52' 2 - 0 Charles De Ketelaere fires in a promising shot which ricochets off the goalkeeper back to Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) inside the box. He unleashes a quick shot into the top of the net. The score is 2:0.
51' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) takes the corner.
51' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Atalanta force a corner. They send men into the box.
48' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!

48' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom right corner. David de Gea guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
47' The ball falls for Moise Kean (Fiorentina) in the box, and he hits a first-time shot at goal that is inadvertently blocked by a defender. A bit unlucky there!
46' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' Matteo Marcenaro has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post.
44' Poor challenge! Simon Sohm (Fiorentina) is penalised for tripping and Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle. A free kick is awarded to Atalanta.

41' 1 - 0 Goal! Charles De Ketelaere finds Odilon Kossounou (Atalanta) with a clever pass. He steps inside his man on the edge of the box and whips a tremendous shot into the top left corner. Fantasy football! 1:0.

38' What an opportunity! Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) leaps high to meet a beautiful cross into the box from the free kick, and he plants a header from near the penalty spot which goes a whisker over the crossbar.
37' Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle and signals a foul after Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) brought his opponent down. Atalanta have a free kick from a promising distance.

37' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
36' Great save! Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom right corner was brilliantly saved by Marco Carnesecchi.

33' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) attempts to find one of his teammates with a cross from the resultant free kick, but he fails to hit the ball properly and sends it off the pitch. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
33' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Fiorentina are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
31' 6:3 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. 3:2 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
29' Isak Hien (Atalanta) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Matteo Marcenaro blows his whistle for a foul.
27' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his low drive towards the left post, but the keeper dives low to keep the ball out.
27' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.

24' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
20' Simon Sohm (Fiorentina) finds some space inside the box and produces a first-time shot that goes high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.
18' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) takes the corner but it's cleared.

18' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat. The ball goes out of play. Atalanta are awarded a corner kick.
17' Dodo (Fiorentina) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
16' The possession of the ball – 60:40.
16' My Gran could have done better! Odilon Kossounou (Atalanta) got himself in a great position on the edge of the box after a pass, but put his shot well wide of the left post.
13' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

13' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the bottom right corner, but David de Gea is well positioned to make a comfortable save. The referee signals a corner kick to Atalanta.

12' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads low towards the middle of the goal, but David de Gea shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
10' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
8' A pass lands at the feet of Odilon Kossounou (Atalanta) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
7' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) tries to find Ederson, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.
5' The resulting corner from Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) comes to nothing.

5' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, Marco Carnesecchi makes a great save to stop his effort. Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina) picks up a rebound inside the penalty area and sends a shot to the left side of the goal, but is denied by a reflex save from Marco Carnesecchi. Now Fiorentina have a corner.
4' Fiorentina enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
3' David de Gea (Fiorentina) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
1' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Fiorentina will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Matteo Marcenaro.
